- **Purpose:** Calculate score per task
This is done after removing GPRless reactions.
- **Input:** summary df
- **Output:** score df

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
```

# load data
```{r}
df_summary <- read.csv("data/SWAP_output/summary.csv")
```

I like having tasks as 'task_xx'
```{r}
df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(Task = as.factor(paste0('task_', Task)))
```

```{r}
tasklist <- read.xlsx('data/SWAP_input/tasklist_test_gtex.xlsx')

tasklist_names <- tasklist %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c('ID', 'DESCRIPTION', 'SHOULD.FAIL')) %>%
  mutate(ID = paste('task', ID, sep = '_'))
```

loading lists of GPRless reactions
these reactions id already have the "_r" and "_f" suffixes 
```{r}
load("data/raw/list_GPRless_transport_rxns.RData")
load("data/raw/list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns.RData")
```

# calculate score

function to make content of the Reactions and Reactions_expression columns into lists 
They were created directly from json file without formatting, which is why they need parsing
```{r}
parse_col <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[][\"']", "", x)             
  strsplit(x, ", ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]  
}

parse_col(df_summary$Reactions[1])
as.numeric(parse_col(df_summary$Reaction_expression[1]))

```

building a df for a specific sample-task combination
this will later be used to compute score
but it can also be used to look at the reactions used by a task and sample
```{r}
build_task_specific_df <- function(df_summary, task, sample){
  
  subset_summary <- subset(df_summary, Sample == sample & Task == task)
  
  df_reactions <- data.frame('rxn_id' = parse_col(subset_summary$Reactions),
                             'rxn_expression' = as.numeric(parse_col(subset_summary$Reaction_expression)),
                             'flux' = as.numeric(parse_col(subset_summary$Reaction_fluxes)))
  
  # attributing NA to GPRless reactions
  df_reactions$rxn_expression[df_reactions$rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_transport_rxns] <- NA
  df_reactions$rxn_expression[df_reactions$rxn_id %in% list_GPRless_non_transport_rxns] <- NA
  
  # attribute NA to temporary exchange reactions (which have -1 has expression)
  df_reactions$rxn_expression[df_reactions$rxn_expression == -1] <- NA 
  
  return(df_reactions)

}

build_task_specific_df(df_summary, 'task_411', df_summary$Sample[3]) 

```

function to calculate score
always excludes GPRless and exchange reactions before calculation
here "rxn_expression" is the estimated Vmax

metric options:
- inverse = 1/sum of penalty
- min = min(rxn_expression)
- average = mean(rxn_expression)
- median = median(rxn_expression)

```{r}
compute_score <- function(df_summary, task, sample, metric){
  
  df_reactions <- build_task_specific_df(df_summary, task, sample)
  
  if (metric == 'inverse'){
    df_reactions$penalties <- df_reactions$flux / df_reactions$rxn_expression
    sum_penalty <- sum(df_reactions$penalties, na.rm = T)
    score <- 1/sum_penalty
    
  } else if (metric == 'min') {
    score <- min(df_reactions$rxn_expression, na.rm = T)
  } else if (metric == 'average') {
    score <- mean(df_reactions$rxn_expression, na.rm = T)
  } else if (metric == 'median') {
    score <-  median(df_reactions$rxn_expression, na.rm = T)
  }
  
  return(data.frame(task, sample, score, metric))
  
}

compute_score(df_summary, 'task_411', df_summary$Sample[3], 'median') 
```

apply the function to all task-sample combination
```{r}
sample_task_combinations <- expand.grid(sample = unique(df_summary$Sample), task = unique(df_summary$Task), stringsAsFactors = F)

list_results_scores <- mapply(compute_score, MoreArgs = list(df_summary = df_summary, metric = 'median'), task= sample_task_combinations$task, sample = sample_task_combinations$sample, SIMPLIFY = F)

df_results_scores <- list_results_scores %>% do.call(rbind,.)
```

# save 
both a long and a wide format
```{r}
save(df_results_scores, file = "data/processed/scores_long.RData")

df_results_scores_wide <- df_results_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(-metric) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'task', values_from = 'score')

save(df_results_scores_wide, file = "data/processed/scores_wide.RData")
```
